expectation: Membrane rings on B cells: few to moderate in number, packed into dense lymphoid follicles or aggregates (tertiary lymphoid structures), with scattered single B cells in the stroma. Should be absent from tumour epithelium.
observed: A: CD20 forms dense compact aggregates in several ROIs, one of them a large follicle-like cluster, with sparse scattered cells elsewhere. B and C (nuclear-chosen fields) are empty, which is expected. D: membrane rings outlining tightly packed cells.
why: Bright membranous CD20 rings sit in compact, follicle-like aggregates confined to a few regions, which is the typical B-cell pattern, not haze or artefact.
notes: CD20 lights dense, well-bounded aggregates resembling B-cell follicles or TLS in several ROIs, and in close-up it shows membrane rings around packed cells. B and C are empty, which fits a clustered population.
